g.title: EleanorRank6Convo3 begins.
g.text: EleanorRank6Convo3 begins.

g.title: j2378700693
g.text: I don't know if you've noticed, but something bloody fantastic has happened.

g.title: j2801031595
g.text: Arthur's singing again. Thank the Gods.

g.title: j1809030030
g.text: Why did he stop?

g.title: j4121338511
g.text: I'm not exactly a fan, but if it makes him happy...

g.title: j3136863201
g.text: I'm glad. He's good at it.

g.title: j501106852
g.text: Performance anxiety. Simple as that.

g.title: j2654702367
g.text: Thank you for putting that as delicately as you did.

g.title: j1310927957
g.text: Isn't he?

g.title: j1321747416
g.text: Hard to believe someone as brave as Arthur could be scared like that.

g.title: j1886319428
g.text: It matters to me that you care.

g.title: j2622221224
g.text: When I think of the effort it took to get him to stand up in front of a crowd of people and sing...

g.title: j1661000684
g.text: What's the crack in his armor?

g.title: j2294674142
g.text: Especially since there are reasons why he gave up singing, which you couldn't possibly have known about.

g.title: j4130122053
g.text: ... the first time he really lost his nerve, I mean.

g.title: j2141842764
g.text: It’s the name. That’s the sodding problem.

g.title: j4119618923
g.text: Not enough moral support?

g.title: j3367284564
g.text: Too many tough crowds?

g.title: j2497184182
g.text: Solstice Carol Concert back in the eighties. Imagine our little man in short trousers doing the solo from How Bright The Dew Upon That Morn.

g.title: j3619364493
g.text: ‘oh your name’s nightingale is it ha ha sing us a song then’

g.title: j1385781413
g.text: Hearing the same joke too often, more like.

g.title: j303417251
g.text: That's quite a visual.

g.title: j327087128
g.text: I don't know that one.

g.title: j1226333822
g.text: Different wankers, same line, all through our lives. Now Viktor’s doing it.

g.title: j3871011299
g.text: He took it so seriously. Weeks and weeks of practice and then, on the night, he bottled it. He hid in the wings and refused to go out.

g.title: j100741296
g.text: Well. I’d sing it for you, but I’m not sure what sort of noise would come out if I tried.

g.title: j1298366856
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2979897877
g.text: How did you convince him?

g.title: j2344688052
g.text: Bloody Techrot. I tried to sing Happy Birthday to Aoi and it sounded like a bullfrog caught in a paper shredder.

g.title: j474120582
g.text: Honestly, I’m proud of Arthur for having the guts to sing at all.

g.title: j3180979704
g.text: I literally kicked his arse. Not proud of it. But it needed doing.

g.title: j1561252606
g.text: I’m sorry. It must be rough, not being able to sing any more.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j1446787951
g.text: The thing is, he didn’t do all that practice for our parents’ sake or to make Mrs Henshaw happy.

g.title: j989752699
g.text: Oh, it’s not much of a loss. I couldn’t sing anyway.

g.title: j2453294223
g.text: He was singing because he loved it. But when the spotlight was on him, he locked up.

g.title: j2928574258
g.text: The closest I came was screaming out lyrics from the Shag Cannons in my bedroom because I wanted to be in Mandy Jellicoe’s band because I fancied her.

g.title: j216222584
g.text: Maybe he just needed to remember how much he loved to do it.

g.title: j1529956010
g.text: Cue my dad hammering on the door and threatening to wash my mouth out with carbolic if he heard any more of that filth.

g.title: j546952527
g.text: Arthur's at his happiest when he can forget about Arthur. When he can lay the ghost of himself to rest and just BE.

g.title: j3528183539
g.text: (I don’t know if you have ‘punk’ where you come from but not being able to sing is more of a requirement than a dealbreaker.)

g.title: j3235555914
g.text: Beer helps.

g.title: j3480652049
g.text: We don't have punk, but we do have Skeg.

g.title: j1767074935
g.text: What happened to the band?

g.title: j3265085110
g.text: And it surely doesn't hurt that Velimir is acting like the dad Arthur would have chosen, if he could have picked one out of a catalogue.

g.title: j458140373
g.text: Don’t you dare drop something like that into the chat and then not elaborate.

g.title: j2316604020
g.text: They didn’t even get to the ‘pity gig in the local pub’ stage.

g.title: j2551515680
g.text: I don't blame him.

g.title: j4093509911
g.text: I'd have thought Velimir and Minerva were a bit too much like your actual parents.

g.title: j3487546374
g.text: I demand you tell me what Skeg is.

g.title: j3145671462
g.text: Word got around that Mandy was planning to spit on the audience and that was that. Shame.

g.title: j511911862
g.text: Arthur's been carting that teddy bear around for months. Now Velimir shows up. It's like destiny sensed a bear-shaped hole in Arthur's life...

g.title: j2907430407
g.text: yeah, well. Maybe the bickering makes him feel at home.

g.title: j2580787413
g.text: Because it sounds like something sold in little ziplock bags on a Ludston estate.

g.title: j571986161
g.text: Who's afraid of a little spit?

g.title: j3689532272
g.text: Spit? Sounds like a Technocyte Coda's idea of a good night.

g.title: j2795902165
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2912838946
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j268299921
g.text: It’s like music except you make it by hitting pipes. And vents. And Corpus helmets. And anything else you can find to hit, really.

g.title: j466314805
g.text: It’s just pointless noise. Only Ventkids like it.

g.title: j3179472449
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j736511760
g.text: It was a different time. Back when punk was real punk.

g.title: j3799199768
g.text: ... sorry. Not my business to speculate. I'm just happy that he's happy.

g.title: j3884906024
g.text: Weird what you can get homesick for, isn't it?

g.title: j1408853212
g.text: It’s a Ventkid thing.

g.title: j2042220366
g.text: Huh. 'Pointless noise'. I've heard that said before.

g.title: j790707326
g.text: I bloody wasn't, I can tell you that much.

g.title: j2479049550
g.text: ... I just thought 'I wish she could see me now'. I think she'd like this version of me.

g.title: j699056071
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j63250298
g.text: I don't think anything's so pointless that it can't be the soundtrack to someone's youth.

g.title: j388012931
g.text: Gods, look at me, I've gone all soppy and nostalgic.

g.title: j129130098
g.text: Hmm. Sounds like survivor music. Wouldn’t mind having a listen if you get the chance to record some for me.

g.title: j1885441735
g.text: I'd better stop. I'm getting sentimental.

g.title: j2962078689
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j81848307
g.text: Best keep it off the Mall speakers, though.

g.title: j723228234
g.text: Better get back to it. Thanks for the ear.
